title: 原helper复用Source canonical准入与owner未知状态拒绝
context: Follow-up addressing adversarial counterexample from PR #6335 / commit aaaf252ea where an incomplete mock payload satisfied readiness, and hardening connector schedule restore without false atomic CAS claims.
summary: Replaced inline deployment heuristic checks in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh with canonical admit_canonical_source_snapshot from services/execution/market_snapshot_admission.py. Converged canonical Source validation through shared admission path with zero future grace, RFC 3339 timezone-awareness, strict typing on schema_version, snapshot_id, symbol, market context, non-bool positive closes, and non-empty string sequences in lineage. Hardened connector inspection and schedule restore with pre-PUT GET, strict field typing, no false atomic CAS claims, and non-zero exit code propagation on failure.
